title: -20 (3-10) Suvaṇṇanikkha -- Janapadakalyāṇī
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || [page 234] 234 LĀBHASAKKĀRA [XVII. 13. 2 2 Idhāham bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalam evam cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi || na cāyam āyasmā || 13 () Suvaṇṇanikkhassa pi hetu || tīṇi pe || 14 () Suvaṇṇanikkhasatassa pi hetu || cattāri pe || 15 () Siṅginikkhassa pi hetu || pañca || pe|| 16 () Siṅginikkhasatassa pi hetu || cha || 17 () Pathaviyā pi jātarūpaparipurāya hetu || satta || 18 () Āmisa kiñcikkha hetu pi || aṭṭha || 19 () Jīvita hetu pi || 20 () Janapadakalyāṇiyā pi hetu bhaseyyāti sampajānamusā bhāseyyāti || || 3 Tam enam passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtam pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantam || || 4 Evam dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 5 Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dutiyo vaggo || || Tassuddānaṃ || || Dve Pāti dve Suvaṇṇā ca || Siṅgīhi apare duve || Pathavī Kiñcikkha Jīvitaṃ || Janapadakalyāṇiyā dasā ti || || CHAPTER III TATIYO VAGGO
